task: PHASE 9: PREMIUM PLAYER EXPERIENCE, AUDIO AND GAMEPLAY PRESENTATION
acceptance_criteria: STEP 1: Audit first-player experience with real browser captures across load, menu, start, controls, train, powerup, crash, retry, and progression.
STEP 2: Establish clear information hierarchy in HUD, menus, and modals, eliminating hazard occlusion and secondary clutter while polishing typography and contrast.

STEP 3: Refine audio architecture in SoundManager: footsteps, jump/land/slide/fast-drop, train pass-by rumble, coin streaks, powerups, UI feedback, volume/mute/intensity controls, browser autoplay resilience.
STEP 4: Polish tactile and visual feedback (near-miss cues, speed perception, landing contact, coin collection bursts, game over transition) while honoring reduced motion and hazard readability.
STEP 5: Enhance replayability and risk/reward choices across ProgressionManager, DailyChallengeManager, SkillComboManager, and JunctionDirector without predatory monetization or reset of player data.
STEP 6: Produce structured heuristic UX audit and human playtesting protocol with concrete observation criteria.
STEP 7: Comprehensive validation: build, UI/sound/gameplay tests, mobile/desktop viewport verification, and before/after evidence comparison.
